intro: Night-market food culture: braised beef noodles, pork rice bowls, fried chicken and the drink that conquered the world, bubble tea.
flavours: Soy sauce, rice wine, five-spice, basil, fried shallots, sesame oil

dishes.name: Beef noodle soup
dishes.what: Taiwan's national dish: chewy noodles and beef shank in a rich, spiced red broth.

dishes.name: Lu rou fan
dishes.what: Soy and five-spice minced pork belly spooned over rice.

dishes.name: Bubble tea
dishes.what: Milk tea with chewy tapioca pearls, invented in Taiwan in the 1980s.

dishes.name: Gua bao
dishes.what: Folded steamed bun stuffed with braised pork belly, pickled greens, peanut powder and coriander.

dishes.name: Stinky tofu
dishes.what: Fermented tofu, deep-fried or stewed: smells strong, tastes mild. Also a Hong Kong street snack.

dishes.name: Oyster omelette
dishes.what: Night-market omelette of oysters and eggs set in chewy starch, with sweet red sauce.

dishes.name: Popcorn chicken
dishes.what: Bite-size fried chicken with basil, salt, pepper and five-spice; giant 'XXL' chicken cutlets are its cousin.

dishes.name: Pineapple cake
dishes.what: Buttery shortbread pastry filled with pineapple jam; the classic Taiwan souvenir.
